chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Humran said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The woman granted the choice (of divorce) is considered divorced from that moment without a formal pronouncement of divorce, and there is no inheritance between them, because the bond of marriage has been severed.

key_terms.الْعِصْمَةَ: The bond of marriage / marital tie
key_terms.الْمُخَيَّرَةُ: The woman granted the option of divorce by her husband
key_terms.تَبِينُ: She is considered divorced / The divorce is established
key_terms.غَيْرِ طَلَاقٍ: Without a formal pronouncement of divorce

ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of a woman who exercises her right of choice in divorce (khayr) regarding the timing of the divorce and inheritance?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that the exercise of the option of divorce (khayr) by the wife results in an immediate, irrevocable separation (baynuna) without the need for a subsequent formal pronouncement of talaq. This ruling underscores the legal finality of the choice, severing the marital bond instantly and thereby terminating the right of inheritance between the spouses from that precise moment.
